name: The Whitley, a Luxury Collection Hotel
insider_take: This transformed 1960s banking tower in Buckhead seamlessly blends mid-century architecture with contemporary luxury, creating Atlanta's most sophisticated urban retreat.
whats_special: The Whitley occupies a meticulously restored 19-story landmark that once housed Atlanta Federal Savings & Loan. Its prime Buckhead location puts you in the heart of the city's upscale shopping and dining district, while the hotel's rooftop pool offers stunning skyline views. The property features original terrazzo floors and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood spaces with natural light, plus a acclaimed restaurant by James Beard Award-winning chef.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on floors 15+ for panoramic views of both downtown Atlanta and the lush Buckhead canopy—these rooms showcase the building's original architectural details best.
dont_miss: The rooftop experience at BeetleCat, where you can enjoy craft cocktails and coastal cuisine with 360-degree city views. Also explore the adjacent Shops Buckhead Atlanta, featuring luxury boutiques like Tom Ford and Hermès, all within a two-minute walk from the hotel's front door.
pros: Prime Buckhead location with upscale shopping and dining access
